response.sql: WITH per_tel AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod FROM signals GROUP BY telescref HAVING AVG(modindex) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) AS overall_avg FROM per_tel) SELECT p.telescref, p.avg_mod AS avg_modindex, p.avg_mod - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall, p.avg_mod / o.overall_avg AS ratio_to_overall FROM per_tel p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_mod > o.overall_avg ORDER BY ratio_to_overall DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Telescopes whose modindex values are all NULL have no average and are excluded from both the overall mean and the results.
The ratio could be undefined if the overall average is zero, but since only telescopes strictly above it are kept, that case does not arise in practice for division by zero beyond the ordinary data.
